utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — when’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it’s next Thursday evening, if that still works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Next Thursday works for me — what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what, but I can help sort it out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time we’re meeting, and who’s bringing the snacks?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the exact time yet, but I can check on it and get back to you. As for snacks, I can bring something simple unless someone else has already volunteered.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — book club. I think I missed the last update, but I’m in if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sure — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too, but I know the meeting time might’ve shifted and we’re picking a new book. I can check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — that’d be great. I’ll wait for your update and then I can catch up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to the others and let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. I’ll be around if they want to hash out the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along and circle back once I’ve heard from them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what book club are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — the one on Maple Street, the neighborhood book club. We’re picking the next read tonight, if you want to join.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh nice, I’m in — what books are we choosing between?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like a clear plan for the book club—same day each month, and a set reading list ahead of time. What book are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—let’s make it the first Thursday each month, with the next three books picked in advance. For our kickoff, how about "The Midnight Library"?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Let’s start with "The Midnight Library" and keep the rest of the dates and books set ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what book are we reading for book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we’re picking a title tonight—want me to check the list and tell you which one won?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please—what’s on the list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge the book club crew—what are we reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got my list here, but I think we still need to pick the title for this week. Want me to check who last suggested a book?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, please do—I'd love to see who suggested the last one and what they had in mind. That should help us pick something everyone’s excited about.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m excited to help with book club. What are you thinking for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d love that, Mara — I’m thinking we choose something cozy but with plenty to discuss, maybe a novel with a little mystery or strong family themes. Do you want me to bring a few options to our next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Rosa — a few cozy mystery or family-theme options would be perfect. I’ll think about it too so we can pick something everyone will enjoy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the snacks and tea covered for book club—do we still need any extra cups or napkins?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re probably good, but a few extra napkins wouldn’t hurt.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll grab a few extra napkins, then—we should be set for book club.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking a new read this week—seems like everyone’s hoping for something easy and fun.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that sounds nice to me. I’d be glad if they picked something light.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Me too—after the last heavy one, I think we all deserve a breezy pick. I’ll let you know if I hear any gossip about the shortlist!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I jump in, what book are we discussing for the club?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re discussing the one I sent out in the email—did you get a chance to see it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I may have missed the email—could you remind me of the title? Then I’ll make sure I’m on the right page.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira — I’m a little swamped, but book club sounds good. What’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries — I’ll swing by and drop off the book club details later, then we can sort out the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just drop them by later and I’ll take a quick look when I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to everyone and we can sort out the details together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, thanks Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll be around to help sort the details once everyone’s looped in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll tell everyone the book club plan and then we can hash out the details together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet—I was thinking we could pick something short and easy this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds good to me—my brain’s been a little scattered lately, so short and easy is perfect. Want to pick something funny, maybe?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting a feel for the book club, but I’d like to hear what you think first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I think the book club’s at its best when everyone brings a different take, even if we don’t all agree. If you want, I can tell you which books have sparked the best conversations so far.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’d like that. Which books got people talking the most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m glad you’re here. What’s the latest with the book club?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa — I don’t have any new book club updates yet, but I can check on the next meeting spot and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Opal — thank you. If you can check the next meeting spot, I’ll keep everything organized on my end.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’ll need the time and place a bit ahead so I can plan my ride.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and place early so you can plan your ride. I’ll keep you posted as soon as it’s set!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. Just send it over when you know, and I’ll plan my ride.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, we’re still doing the book club at your place this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s right — I just want to double-check the day and time before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the day and time for me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple. I’d say we meet, choose the next book, and set the date before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works for me — I’ll probably be a little late, but I can still vote on the next book and dates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem — just send your vote when you can, and we’ll keep the plan moving. I’ll bring the book list so we can decide quickly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the book club so far—what’s it like?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s pretty cozy—mostly a few of us trading thoughts over tea, with plenty of side chatter and book recommendations. If you like, I can tell you what we’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely—I'd like that. What are we reading next?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help. What were we deciding again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We were sorting out the next book and when to meet — I think we were leaning toward next Thursday at my place. Want me to resend the details?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please — I’d appreciate that. Next Thursday at your place sounds right, and the details will help me keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — what time is the book club meeting? I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 7 pm. If that’s tight, I can save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that works for me — I should be free by then. Save me a seat, and I’ll see you at 7.
